name: Shizuoka
registryCustodian: Shizuoka City municipal GIS and tax/municipal records offices are evidenced as local custodians for the listed parcel-reference map and cadastral-map issuance procedure.
serviceSummary: Official city documentation establishes a local parcel-reference/cadastral publication lead. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified.
queryOutcomes: English and Japanese first-party discovery queries found the official Shizuoka City GIS page, cadastral-survey page and cadastral-map application page. URLs and outcomes are recorded in the city record.
requestOutcomes: The legacy WAGMAP portal returned HTTP 200 and its inline configuration was inspected; it exposed only the road-ledger map. The newer city.geocloud.jp host linked by the official page returned HTTP 403. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, private token, unsafe field request or TLS exception was used.

schemaAndCrs.reason: No parcel feature response was available.

coverage.note: No exact-point query was performed because no parcel endpoint was established; this is not evidence of absence.

uncertainty: The current geocloud host may expose a public parcel-reference layer through a browser bootstrap unavailable to this attempt.
The city documentation describes parcel-reference maps and cadastral maps but does not by itself establish vector geometry access or stable native IDs.
Packet completion records research execution only; it is not source integration or admission.
reviewConclusion: Retain the official local registry/GIS lead, but hold runtime readiness and retain no parcel sample until an independent reviewer verifies a real anonymous parcel adapter and safe native identity.
